prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Launch", "body": "Your pet is getting ready to land on your desktop screen."}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Hero Journey Redesign: Redesigns the initial story screen layout to a full_bleed video-backed hero layout to immerse users before path choice.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Experience a living pet directly on your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "video", "asset": "asset:hero_bg", "style": "plain"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Companion Trait Selection Sub-Flow: Inserts a new sub-flow screen 'new_trait_selection' between photo upload and certificate adoption to let users define pet personality.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_trait_selection", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_trait_selection": {"headline": "Choose Pet Personality", "body": "Select traits for your desktop companion.", "layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Playful vs Calm", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Adds an explicit account persistence hint under sign-in options explaining how existing pets will stay connected.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your desktop pet and settings remain saved safely across sessions."}}
4: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Photo Upload Layout: Reorganizes the upload_photos screen into a two-column side-by-side view with live preview and photo guidelines.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Upload Pet Photo", "body": "Clear front-facing photos yield the best desktop pet results.", "show_progress": true}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_archetype_preview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_archetype_preview": {"headline": "Meet the Companions", "body": "Discover what your desktop companion can do.", "layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:archetype_demo", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [home, wait_info] Interactive Waiting Tip Carousel: Adds a rotating tip carousel component on the waiting screen explaining desktop interactions during generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop to open quick controls.", "style": "calm"}]}}
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Control & Visibility Intro Copy: Updates home_intro headline and body to explicitly explain how to summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Live!", "body": "Click your pet on the desktop anytime to chat, hide, or access companion settings.", "button_label": "Start Exploring"}}
8: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Friend Selection Stage Redesign: Redesigns pick_friend screen using a stage layout with animated pet interaction previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your Base Companion", "body": "Select a desktop friend to start customizing.", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_idle", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [sign_in, incentive] Account Protection Sign-In Incentive: Adds a clear account status badge highlighting cloud save protection on the sign_in screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Save Active: Keeps your pet safe across re-installs", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a wait visualizer with estimated countdown for pet creation, which is a real wait allowed by rule 5.
Redesigns story screen with video layout while still introducing the pet.
Inserts a valid personality trait selection screen inside onboarding without removing mandatory steps.
Adds a helpful hint explaining account persistence on the sign-in screen.
Redesigns photo upload layout to two columns while preserving screen job and required flow.
Adds a new archetype preview screen within onboarding without removing or skipping required steps.
Adds an interactive tip carousel component to the waiting screen during pet generation.
Updates home_intro text to explain controls; home_intro is part of onboarding and allowed to change.
Redesigns friend selection stage while retaining its core function of letting the user choose a pet.
Adds an account protection status badge to the sign-in screen without violating fair design rules.
